title: OSC 21 — Color scheme (dark/light) notification
summary: OSC 21 is sent by the terminal to report color scheme changes: OSC 21 ; dark ST or OSC 21 ; light ST. Applications can query with OSC 21 ; ? ST.

terminator_detail.note: ECMA-48 mandates ST; BEL is widely accepted.

params.name: Dark mode
params.meaning: OSC 21 ; dark ST reports dark mode.

params.name: Light mode
params.meaning: OSC 21 ; light ST reports light mode.

params.name: Query scheme
params.meaning: OSC 21 ; ? ST queries the current color scheme.

gotchas: OSC 21 is triggered by DECSET 2031 (color scheme reporting).
Supported by iTerm2, kitty, WezTerm, Windows Terminal.
TUIs can use this to adapt their palette without polling.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: OSC 21 renders as a byte-exact ST-terminated OSC sequence.
